item.title: Pixel 11 Pro XL review: Snappier cameras can’t hide an iterative upgrade
item.description: Google’s Pixel 11 Pro XL brings snappier cameras and genuinely useful AI features like Rambler, but its iterative upgrades may not be enough to tempt recent Pixel owners.

item.title: 'A generational Call of Duty game' — After almost ten hours hands-on, I think Modern Warfare 4 could revolutionize the long-running series
item.description: Modern Warfare 4 is shaping up to be a generational Call of Duty experience if the ongoing beta is anything to go by.

item.title: EcoFlow’s Stream home batteries arrive to power the UK’s plug-in solar boom — but installation still isn’t DIY
item.description: With plug-in solar soon to be legal in the UK, you may be investing — and these batteries let you store your generated power.

item.title: Amazon just hiked the prices for Echo, Fire TV, and Kindle products by up to 60 percent
item.description: Citing "significant increases in memory and storage component costs," in a statement given to Fortune, Amazon has raised prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs, and Eeros by up to 60 percent. The cheapest products in Amazon's lineup were hit hardest, with the Echo Dot smart speaker jumping from $49.99 to $79.99. The Fire TV Stick […]

item.title: The difference between Shot with IMAX and Filmed for IMAX
item.description: A movie can be both "Filmed for IMAX" and shot with IMAX cameras, which is why the two labels are easy to confuse.

item.title: Rebelle 8 review: This impressive painting software let me turn my MacBook into a full-blown canvas
item.description: Rebelle 8 from Escape Motions is all about recreating the real-world effect of painting with brushes and paints on a canvas in a virtual environment.

item.title: Boulanger fait chuter le prix du nouveau TCL 75C89L, un TV Mini LED lumineux idéal pour le cinéma et la PS5
item.description: Le TCL 75C89L est un téléviseur 4K qui embarque le Dolby Atmos et le Dolby Vision pour des soirées cinéma aux petits oignons. Les gamers ne seront pas en reste avec les quatre ports HDMI 2.1. Enfin, toute la famille sera convaincue par cette remise de 240 euros chez Boulanger.

item.title: Experts warn 2,000 hacked WordPress sites were secretly running a global crime ring
item.description: Compromised WordPress sites have been used by a global operation, using trusted websites to deliver malware, instruct infected devices, and even store stolen documents.

item.title: Saily Ultra eSIM Premum Plan Review: Packed With Perks
item.description: For uninterrupted service as you country-hop, the Saily Ultra eSIM works well and comes with plentiful perks. It’s pricey though.

item.title: An okay laptop with 16GB of RAM is better than a nice laptop with 8GB, and this $520 HP OmniBook proves it
item.description: Laptop prices are out of whack. $500 used to get you a tolerable laptop, and $900 got you a really good one. They often had similar CPU, RAM, and storage options because that stuff was comparatively cheap; the difference was often in build quality and screen rather than power. But RAMageddon has thrown everything off. […]

item.description: If you want to display media from your phone on a TV screen, you'll need to follow these steps to use AirPlay or screen mirroring.
